title: Write unit tests for taskMerger.ts
description: Write comprehensive Vitest unit tests for taskMerger.ts covering ID assignment, schema validation, existing task preservation, empty input handling, and file isolation.
acceptanceCriteria: IDs assigned sequentially from max existing ID + 1 test passes
Schema validation rejects tasks missing required fields test passes
Existing tasks in the file are not modified test passes
Empty newTasks array adds nothing and returns correctly test passes
All taskMerger unit tests pass with npm test

steps.details: Create test file with temp dir setup. Import mergeTasks, fs, path.
Create tasks.json with tasks having max ID of 5. Call mergeTasks with 3 new tasks. Verify new tasks have IDs 6, 7, 8.
Test: new task missing 'title' throws ZodError. Test: existing 3 tasks remain unchanged after merge. Test: empty array adds nothing.
Run `npm test` and verify all taskMerger tests pass.
